"National Heroes Welfare Trust Fund" means the
trust fund so named which is maintained and managed
under an Instrument of Trust executed on the 3lst
day of October 1968 between the Managerial Board of
the said Trust Fund of the one part and the Public
Trustee, Malaysia of the other part.

3. (1) The National Defence Fund shall, on the com-
mencement of this Act, be dissolved and all monies,
securities and other assets standing to its credit in the
trust account maintained in respect of it under section
9 of the Financial Procedure Act 1957, or otherwise
belonging to or due to be paid into the said Fund,
immediately before the commencement of this Act
shall, on the commencement of this Act, be transferred
to the National Heroes Welfare Trust Fund and vest
in the truste2 of the said Trust Fund, and such transfer
and vesting shall have effect without any document of
transfer, conveyance or assignment whatsoever.

(2) The monies, securities and other assets trans-
ferred under subsection (1) shall be held in trust and
utilised under the National Heroes Welfare Trust Fund
in accordance with the terms and for the purposes, as
may for the time being, be set out in the Instrument of
Trust in respect thereof.

(3) All rights and liabilities which immediately before
the commencement of this Act were those of the
National Defence Fund shall, on the commencement
of this Act, devolve on the National Heroes Welfare
Trust Fund.

DICETAK OLEH HAJI MOKHTAR SHAMSUDDIN, J.S.D., S.M.T., K.M.N., P.LS.,
KETUA PENGARAH PERCETAKAN NEGARA, KUALA LUMPUR
